510310.name: Multi-Barrel Machine Gun
510310.description:
Fires a barrage of machine gun bullets, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Black Smith generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Multi-Barrel Machine Gun. While the barrier is up, only Water Code Nikkes can deal damage.

510311.name: Explosive Tentacle
510311.description: Retracts its tentacle after dealing massive damage to the Nikke it stabbed.

510316.name: Highly Concentrated Particle Cannon
510316.description: Fires a highly concentrated particle cannon, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

510317.name: Large Caliber Rifle
510317.description: Fires large caliber rifles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. These rifles can be destroyed and will no longer fire once they are gone.

510319.name: Mechanical Mine Missile
510319.description: Fires a volley of missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The missiles can be intercepted.

510321.name: Corrosive Tentacle
510321.description:
Stabs a Nikke with its tentacles. The Nikke who is hit will be rendered temporarily unable to act.
Black Smith generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Corrosive Tentacle. While the barrier is up, only Water Code Nikkes can deal damage.
